metadata.question: Did the area around Windhoek, Nambia appear greener on February 7, 2021 as compared to the same region on January 29, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Windhoek, Namibia (approximately -22.57°, 17.08°) - Dates: February 7, 2021 vs January 29, 2020 (single day comparisons) - Collection: Sentinel-2 for vegetation analysis (NDVI), fallback to Landsat 8 if needed - Need to define a region "around Windhoek" - will use a buffer of ~50km 2. Masking strategy: - YES, mask clouds - we want to see vegetation greenness, not clouds - Use SCL band for Sentinel-2 or QA_PIXEL for Landsat 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: NDVI can legitimately be 0 or negative (bare soil, water) - C1: If no images found for either date - C2: If images exist but all pixels masked out - C3: If NDVI calculation returns None/NaN or values outside [-1, 1] - Compare mean NDVI: if 2021 > 2020, answer A (greener), else B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const windhoek = ee.Geometry.Point([17.08, -22.57]); const region = windhoek.buffer(50000); // 50km buffer around Windhoek const date1 = '2020-01-29'; const date2 = '2021-02-07'; // 2. Data Acquisition & Check // Try Sentinel-2 first let col2020 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(1, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80)); let col2021 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(1, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80)); const size2020 = await col2020.size().getInfo(); const size2021 = await col2021.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2020 Sentinel-2 Images: ${size2020}`); console.log(`2021 Sentinel-2 Images: ${size2021}`); // Fallback to Landsat 8 if needed if (size2020 === 0 || size2021 === 0) { console.log('Falling back to Landsat 8...'); col2020 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(1, 'day')); col2021 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(1, 'day')); const ls_size2020 = await col2020.size().getInfo(); const ls_size2021 = await col2021.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2020 Landsat 8 Images: ${ls_size2020}`); console.log(`2021 Landsat 8 Images: ${ls_size2021}`); if (ls_size2020 === 0 || ls_size2021 === 0) { console.log('No data available for comparison.'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 3. Processing - Cloud masking and NDVI calculation function maskS2clouds(image) { const scl = image.select('SCL'); const mask = scl.neq(3).and(scl.neq(8)).and(scl.neq(9)).and(scl.neq(10)); return image.updateMask(mask); } function addNDVI(image) { const ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI'); return image.addBands(ndvi); } const img2020 = col2020.map(maskS2clouds).map(addNDVI).median(); const img2021 = col2021.map(maskS2clouds).map(addNDVI).median(); // Check pixel counts const count2020 = await img2020.select('NDVI').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); const count2021 = await img2021.select('NDVI').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log(`2020 Valid Pixels: ${count2020}`); console.log(`2021 Valid Pixels: ${count2021}`); if (count2020 === 0 || count2021 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 4. Calculation const ndvi2020 = await img2020.select('NDVI').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); const ndvi2021 = await img2021.select('NDVI').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); // 5. Validation & Final Answer console.log(`2020-01-29 Mean NDVI: ${ndvi2020?.toFixed(3)}`); console.log(`2021-02-07 Mean NDVI: ${ndvi2021?.toFixed(3)}`); if (ndvi2020 === null || ndvi2021 === null || isNaN(ndvi2020) || isNaN(ndvi2021) || ndvi2020 < -1 || ndvi2020 > 1 || ndvi2021 < -1 || ndvi2021 > 1) { console.log('Invalid NDVI calculation.'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (ndvi2021 > ndvi2020) { console.log(`2021 was greener (NDVI: ${ndvi2021.toFixed(3)} vs ${ndvi2020.toFixed(3)})`); console.log('A'); } else { console.log(`2021 was not greener (NDVI: ${ndvi2021.toFixed(3)} vs ${ndvi2020.toFixed(3)})`); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
